baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive construction صاحبكم at word 2 is set directly against بمجنون at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sustained companionship is publicly testable association, whereas madness is a covering of reason. The possessive makes the addressees' accumulated contact with the speaker the evidence against the alleged mental veil.

activation_trace.role: Close, sustained association supplies the long public observation on which the denial rests.
Madness as a veil over reason identifies the specific impairment that shared observation is invoked to disprove.

changed_reading.before: A bare assertion that the addressed community's acquaintance is not mad.
changed_reading.after: An evidentiary challenge: your own prolonged life with this companion contradicts the claim that his reason is covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The صحب and جنن roots permit two opposed conditions around the same person: preserving accompaniment and disabling cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: The companion root can carry keeping through accompaniment, while the negated predicate names reason hidden by madness. The verse can therefore distinguish an extraordinary state sustained by attendance from one produced by cognitive occlusion.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies a positive account of how the companion is kept through his task.
The mental veil supplies the rejected alternative to preserving accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: The companion is simply free of mental illness.
changed_reading.after: What attends and sustains the companion is not a covering that disables his reason.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated مجنون belongs to a root inventory containing both hidden beings and the veiling of reason, while صاحبكم keeps the person socially visible and known.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch neighborhood leaves two rival hidden-cause explanations live: an obscured mind or intrusion attributed to an unseen agent. Negation resists both ways of replacing the known companion with an inaccessible cause.

activation_trace.role: Familiar association keeps the claimant within ordinary communal observation rather than behind an inaccessible cause.
Hidden spirit beings supply the exploratory external-agent hypothesis carried in the root's semantic neighborhood.
Mental covering supplies the internal-impairment hypothesis paired with the hidden-agent alternative.

changed_reading.before: Only an allegation of insanity is denied.
changed_reading.after: The denial also resists explaining a socially known speaker by an opaque hidden cause, whether inside his cognition or assigned outside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence destabilizes celestial and geological reference points: a luminary is wrapped, stars fall in disorder, and solid elevations are displaced. Against that loss of ordinary landmarks, صاحبكم offers a different kind of fixed point, the addressees' durable social memory of a person.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association functions as a human-scale evidentiary landmark when larger landmarks are overturned.
Wrapping and folding together removes the sun's ordinary orienting exposure and begins the loss of stable reference points.
Scattered plunging turns the stars from fixed guides into disordered motion.
A gathered, elevated solidity supplies the expected material landmark that the sequence then removes.
Displacement and removal reverse the mountain's apparent fixity and sharpen the contrast with remembered companionship.

structural_cues: Ayat 81:1-3 repeatedly pair a familiar cosmic or terrestrial object with a passive loss of its ordinary stability.
The focus verse later appeals to a second-person social relation rather than to a remote sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destabilized landmarks and long association; I infer that social memory is offered as a surviving epistemic anchor. The live alternative is that the opening transformations establish only eschatological scale, without this evidentiary contrast.

changed_reading.before: Shared familiarity is merely a reason to reject an insult.
changed_reading.after: When even the usual map of the world is overturned, the community's tested familiarity with its companion remains a deliberately local ground for judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Records are opened, an overhead cover is stripped away, and each self comes to know what it has brought into presence. This disclosure sequence activates the general covering inside جنن: calling the companion mad can now be heard as an attempt to place a mental screen over testimony arriving in an environment of forced unveiling.

activation_trace.role: Covering from perception broadens the negated predicate into an epistemic screen rather than only a diagnostic label.
The veil over reason locates the alleged screen specifically in the companion's cognition.
Opening, spreading, and branching make formerly folded records available to inspection.
Removing a cover supplies the sequence's clearest material reversal of concealment.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive result produced when coverings are removed.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness turn what was absent into evidence confronting the self.

structural_cues: The passive disclosure transformations of 81:10-13 culminate in active knowing at 81:14.
The focus predicate carries a cover-root shortly after that unveiling sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated opening, stripping, presence, and a focus root of covering; I infer that the madness accusation functions rhetorically as re-covering disclosed evidence. It may alternatively remain a literal charge with no meta-rhetorical force.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies that the companion's mind is veiled.
changed_reading.after: The verse also exposes the accusation itself as a counter-unveiling move: it tries to hide disclosed testimony by relocating the cover into its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence pairs selves, stages reciprocal questioning, and exposes killing. It makes social relations answerable rather than disposable. In that field, the possessive in صاحبكم does more than cite familiarity: it makes the addressees answer for how they classify someone bound to their own communal history.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies the social bond for which the addressees are made interpretively accountable.
The living self supplies the accountable personal unit that is subsequently paired and questioned.
Joining each counterpart to its counterpart makes relation and classification part of the reckoning mechanism.
Reciprocal questioning supplies an adjudicative scene in which imposed classifications can be challenged.
Taking life supplies the extreme result of treating a person as disposable and brings relational judgment under scrutiny.

structural_cues: The branchless و ء د occurrence at 81:8 is used only as a structural cue locating the killed child inside the question-and-answer scene.
The second-person plural suffix in صاحبكم returns responsibility from an isolated accused person to the addressing community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, questioning, killing, and a possessive companionship construction; I infer a shared logic of accountability for relational classification. The alternative is that the victim sequence and the defense of the companion remain independent scenes.

changed_reading.before: Your acquaintance does not deserve the label mad.
changed_reading.after: Because he is your own long-associated companion, the label also exposes the community's accountability for misclassifying a person it knows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first names a tree-covered garden that is driven near and later names the alleged covering of the companion's reason. The root echo creates a spatial-epistemic inversion: a hidden or covered domain can be brought into proximity, while the mind receiving and communicating it need not itself be covered.

activation_trace.role: The veiled mind supplies the denied cognitive form of covering.
A garden covered by trees supplies a positive, spatial form of hiddenness distinct from cognitive impairment.
Movement forcefully toward nearness makes a covered reality approach rather than remain epistemically inaccessible.

structural_cues: The identical جنن root occurs at 81:13 and 81:22 in sharply different surface forms.
The first occurrence is paired with nearness; the second is placed inside emphatic negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root's garden and mental-cover branches plus movement toward proximity; I infer a contrast between hidden reality and a disabled knower. The recurrence may instead be ordinary polysemy with no designed cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: Anything associated with hiddenness makes the companion suspect.
changed_reading.after: A covered reality may be brought near through disclosure without implying that the companion who encounters it has a covered mind.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayat 81:19-21 describe utterance, dispatch, gathered strength, established capacity, obedience, and trust. This converts the focus contrast from a private judgment about one person's state into a relay question: the familiar companion is the publicly accessible link of an ordered transmission rather than the autonomous producer of disordered speech.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing accompany another supplies the coupling by which bearer and transmitted content remain linked.
A veiled mind supplies the rival model of a broken receiving link.
Speech brought into articulation supplies the payload whose provenance is being tested.
Sending and being set in motion supplies delegated transmission rather than self-originating speech.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies integrity under the load of transmission.
Capacity and enablement supply an authorized ability to carry out the dispatch.
Obedient compliance places the carrier inside an ordered command relation.
Security and settled trust supply the relay's reliability criterion immediately before the focus denial.

structural_cues: The focus verse follows an uninterrupted chain of attributes attached to a messenger and its utterance.
The shift from رسول to صاحبكم moves from delegated office to the addressees' own accessible relationship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trusted, empowered dispatch and then the known companion; I infer an end-to-end relay in which the focus person is the human-facing link. A live alternative is that the messenger description and صاحبكم defend distinct agents without asking the reader to model the topology between them.

changed_reading.before: The companion is defended as a sane individual speaking on his own.
changed_reading.after: The companion is defended as the inspectable receiving and delivering link of an authorized, strong, and trusted transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel negations at 81:22, 81:24, and 81:25 test three different failure points. A veiled receiver would corrupt apprehension, a withholding carrier would block delivery of what is hidden from sight, and a rebellious expelled source would corrupt origin. The focus verse is thus the receiver-integrity member of a compact provenance audit.

activation_trace.role: Known close association makes receiver integrity open to communal inspection.
Mental covering supplies the rejected receiver-side failure mode.
What is screened from eyes supplies the inaccessible content that must pass through the channel.
Holding back or withholding supplies the rejected channel-side failure mode.
Articulated speech supplies the output whose source is explicitly tested.
A defiant rebellious agent supplies the rejected source-side failure mode.
Expulsion and distancing mark the rejected source as outside the trusted relation.

structural_cues: Ayat 81:22, 81:24, and 81:25 repeat وما with a predicate introduced by بـ or a closely parallel negated construction.
The intervening sight statement at 81:23 supplies positive evidence between the first and later exclusions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three parallel exclusions concerning mind, withheld unseen content, and corrupt speech-origin; I assign them receiver, channel, and source positions in one integrity chain. They may alternatively be independent rebuttals rather than a designed systems model.

changed_reading.before: Verse 22 independently rejects an insult about the companion.
changed_reading.after: Verse 22 certifies the receiver in a three-part integrity argument: cognition is not occluded, disclosure is not withheld, and speech does not come from the rejected source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companion's experience is followed by sight at a far horizon made manifest, then by rejection of conjectural speech about hidden matters. This creates an abductive reversal: direct or inwardly discerning vision has a presented object and setting, whereas the madness label is itself an unsupported guess about an unseen mental state.

activation_trace.role: A reason-veiling diagnosis supplies the hidden internal condition alleged by the addressees.
Vision by eye or insight supplies positive apprehension rather than mere uncontrolled impression.
A distant horizon supplies an external spatial limit at which the vision is located.
Manifest appearance and disclosure make the horizon scene evidentially available.
Guessing speech about the unseen supplies the inferior epistemic procedure now reflected back onto the accusation.

structural_cues: The positive ولقد رآه statement immediately follows the negative madness statement.
The sequence moves from a denied internal diagnosis to a located act of seeing and then to rejection of corrupt-source speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies located vision, manifestness, and conjecture about the unseen; I infer that these reverse the evidentiary burden onto the accusers' diagnosis. The alternative is that رجم contributes only expulsion here and not the branch of conjectural speech.

changed_reading.before: The companion must prove that an unusual experience is not madness.
changed_reading.after: The located and manifest act of seeing gives the companion a positive account, while the unseen diagnosis of madness begins to look like the accusers' own conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the source exclusions, the discourse asks where the addressees are going, calls the message a reminder and guiding mark for the worlds, and opens a path toward straightness. Protective companionship becomes wayfinding accompaniment: the familiar bearer and his message keep travelers oriented rather than expressing disordered wandering.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the companion's functional role as keeping travelers oriented.
A route, destination, or adopted way supplies the path whose direction is challenged.
A reminder that actively causes recollection supplies the orienting intervention.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward something extends the reminder into a universally legible sign.
Straightness, balance, and level alignment supply the destination of the companion's orienting work.

structural_cues: The question أين تذهبون is followed by reminder and straightness language in 81:27-28.
The local possessive your in 81:22 precedes the widened scope to the worlds in 81:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, reminder, guiding mark, straightness, and protective accompaniment; I infer a wayfinding function for the focus companion. The later exhortation may instead be a separate consequence and need not retroactively specify صاحبكم.

changed_reading.before: The verse only clears a false diagnosis from a familiar person.
changed_reading.after: The familiar companion is also the near, testable bearer of an orienting reminder: rejecting him as mad is itself a directional error.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because distance and cutoff are not the ordinary foreground of شيطان in 81:25. It remains valid because close association is explicit in the focus root and the later verse directly rejects the alternative speech-source. Render it as relational geometry sharpening the source contrast, not as a claim that the two lexemes are antonyms in every use.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صاحبكم anchors the reading in the community's close association with the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Close sustained association supplies the near and socially continuous pole of the contrast.
Articulated speech identifies the object whose relational origin is being contested.
Distance and cutoff supply the remote, severed pole rejected as the speech's origin.

changed_reading.before: The text chooses between a sane man and a demonic utterance as unrelated denials.
changed_reading.after: It opposes two source relations: the speaker known through enduring nearness and an utterance attributed to a distant, cut-off origin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the courier or agent branch of جري is distant from the immediate celestial image in 81:16. It remains anchored through the later explicit messenger and the focus branch of making something accompany another. Downstream prose should present it as a lexical foreshadowing of delegated carriage, not as a replacement identification of the running objects.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The صحب root at word 2 can picture one thing being made to accompany or carry along with another.

activation_trace.role: Making something accompany or be carried along supplies the coupling at the focus endpoint.
A running agent, courier, or delegate supplies an unexpected carrier image inside the oath sequence.
Dispatch and setting forth stabilize the earlier carrier image as delegated motion.

changed_reading.before: The companion is a static biographical witness to his own sanity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the companion is the visible endpoint of a delegated movement already shadowed by the running courier image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because the hide-with-hair sense of صحب is remote from صاحبكم. It remains packet-anchored through the exact focus branch and the nearby stripping image, and it produces a coherent evidence metaphor. Render only as a qualified material analogy: retained observable surface versus an alleged invisible cover, never as a lexical gloss of صاحبكم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes a صحب noun with a جنن predicate, whose inventories include retained surface and concealment.

activation_trace.role: A hide kept with its hair attached supplies the image of an exterior history retained for inspection.
Covering from perception supplies the invisible layer alleged beneath that inspectable history.
Stripping skin from a body activates the material contrast between an attached surface and a removed cover.

changed_reading.before: The addressees can ignore the companion's visible history and posit a hidden mental defect.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, his long-attached public history remains on the surface as evidence even while the accusation invents an unseen cover beneath it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because yielding after resistance is a nonforeground branch of صحب and may describe a derived form rather than the noun in isolation. It remains anchored by the focus root and is activated by explicit obedience and straightness later in the packet. Render as a possible effect on the audience's relation to the companion, not as the dictionary meaning of صاحبكم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressees are named as companions through the possessive relationship, leaving that relationship capable of change.

activation_trace.role: Yielding and becoming compliant after resistance supplies a possible transformation of the audience's companionship.
Obedient compliance activates the possibility that resistance can become responsive relation.
Straightness and balance supply the alignment toward which changed responsiveness would move.

changed_reading.before: The verse only describes the companion and leaves the audience unchanged.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clearing the madness charge opens a resistant companionship to become responsive and aligned.

strongest_changes: The possessive companion construction became evidence from long public association, not merely a familiar epithet.
The disclosure sequence turned madness-as-cover into a proposed screen over testimony and made the accusation itself look like a re-covering maneuver.
The parallel denials around 81:22-25 made the focus verse the receiver-integrity check within a larger receiver, channel, and source argument.
Located sight and manifestness shifted the burden toward the accusers' conjectural diagnosis, while the closing path language recast companionship as orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus polarity between sustained accompaniment and concealed reason supported coexisting social, epistemic, transmission, spatial, and material models. The same-root garden echo, the syntax of repeated negation, and branch-distant carrier and surface images produced changes that a single sane-versus-mad paraphrase would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from cosmic unveiling to the accusation as rhetorical re-covering is reader-supplied rather than grammatically explicit.
The جنن recurrence may intentionally contrast a covered garden with a covered mind, or it may be ordinary polysemy without cross-activation.
The packet does not itself specify the topology between the messenger description and صاحبكم, so the relay model remains abductive.
The صحب branches of retained hide and post-resistance compliance, and the جري courier branch, should remain qualified outliers rather than surface glosses.
